All tests pass. The fix works correctly:

`slugify('Hello,  World!')` now returns `'hello-world'` instead of `'hello---world-'`.

The issue was that the regex pattern `[^a-z0-9]+` excluded both letters and digits but also excluded hyphens (`-`). This meant when processing `'Hello,  World!'`, the commas and spaces were replaced with hyphens. 

By changing the pattern to `[^a-z0-9-]` (adding `-` to the allowed characters), we now only exclude non-alphanumeric characters except hyphens, which properly handles punctuation like commas while keeping hyphens in the output.
